### Changed

- refactor(element-resolution): retire ElementFinder — delete dead lookups and move trait queries to narrow interfaces ([#10271](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10271)) (android, ios)
- refactor(element-resolution): move remaining by-text, by-ID and container lookups off DefaultElementFinder ([#10269](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10269)) (android, ios)

- Keep-screen-awake restore swallows its failure, so a retained device can carry the previous execution's stay-awake setting ([#12291](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/12291))

- Managed slots: a new slot device on a reused emulator serial never gets its CtrlProxy adb forward; readiness retries 810 s, the AVD is deleted and the slot is left provisioning ([#12281](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/12281))
- sendKeys into a prototype text field: key-event modes refuse, no-layer targets skip prototype truth, stale bindings, insert/numeric comparison ([#12241](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/12241))

- sendKeys layer:"prototype" mode:"ime" reports a false "IME partial commit" when the app behind the prototype has a focused text field; the read-back reads the app's field ([#12224](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/12224)) (android, daemon)
- videoRecording: after a daemon SIGKILL the rehydrated owner cannot stop its recording and can start a second one; two screenrecord processes run on the held device until release ([#12223](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/12223)) (android, daemon)

### Changed

- test: action unit suites pay a 300-470 ms cold import of heavy SDKs (Anthropic, MCP, Jimp, Sharp, Kysely), likely the CI unit-lane wall-clock cost ([#10429](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10429)) (ci)
- explore: decide candidate semantics before retiring DefaultElementSelector (41 of 258 tap selectors change index under the resolver) ([#10287](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10287))
- element-resolution: retire ElementFinder.ts in favour of ElementResolver ([#10281](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10281)) (android, ios)
- daemon: twelve stream socket servers repeat the module-global start/stop singleton, and the video and WebRTC servers each resolve the target device their own way ([#10279](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10279)) (daemon)
- ctrlproxy(android): start_recording/stop_recording only set a flag nothing reads, and CLAUDE.md describes the isVisibleToUser bypass as systemui-only ([#10277](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10277)) (android)
- observe: TakeScreenshot starts a cache-directory sweep on every construction, and OBSERVE_RESULT_CACHE_TTL_MS is defined in two modules ([#10276](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10276)) (performance)
- ctrlproxy: iOS request_hierarchy_if_stale sends no sinceTimestamp and shares the request_hierarchy handler; Android forward-list parsers skip unexpected rows without a log ([#10275](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10275)) (android, ios)
- android: avdmanager and sdkmanager clients duplicate the spawn/timeout runner, parseAvdList does not separate unloadable AVDs, and the emulator console dials localhost ([#10274](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10274)) (android)
- mcp: setup timing is keyed by device not session, a session-binding conflict throws a bare Error, and the device-loss cancel reason is matched by prefix at four sites ([#10273](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10273))
- devicePool: four captured-entry predicates, a duplicated start-additional sequence, and autolock gating read from the environment at eight call sites ([#10272](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10272)) (daemon)
- element-resolution: one selection-strategy enum, nested containers and unique on highlight, pinchOn parity, stale docs ([#10270](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10270)) (android, ios)
- refactor(element-resolution): retire DefaultElementSelector in favour of the resolver-backed selector ([#10268](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10268)) (android, ios)
- refactor(element-resolution): one helper each for unique-strategy propagation and the strict-scope check ([#10267](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10267)) (android, ios)
- epic(plan): plan execution, barriers, critical sections, recording, and navigation graph ([#6380](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6380))
- epic(android/ctrlproxy): Kotlin helper threading, wire-frame construction, and extraction cost ([#6376](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6376)) (android, epic)
- epic(observe): capture caching, freshness semantics, and hierarchy shape consistency ([#6374](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6374)) (android, ios, epic)
- epic(ctrlproxy): MCP to CtrlProxy transport contract, correlation, and reconnection ([#6373](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6373)) (android, ios, epic)
- Swift-6 strict-concurrency pass for ios/auto-mobile-sdk (largest; iOS-floor bump decision) ([#5839](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/5839)) (ios)
- ctrlproxy(ios physical): put the iproxy tunnel behind one typed tunnel client ([#4096](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/4096)) (ios, devxp, testing, needs-human)

### Fixed

- CtrlProxy forward teardown has no ownership check, so one daemon can remove another daemon's adb forward ([#10690](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10690)) (android, daemon)
- iOS CtrlProxy: a corrupted cached test bundle is never repaired and the error gives no recovery step ([#10650](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10650)) (ios)
- iOS getApple waits the full 360 s on a runner frozen at launch instead of restarting it ([#10649](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10649)) (ios)
- ios-runner: put a deadline on live XCUI app queries in gesture and hierarchy requests ([#10640](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10640)) (ios)
- tapOn refuses 'Discover' in the iPad top tab bar as covered by the navigation bar ([#10635](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10635)) (ios)
- observe may return a cached hierarchy without a stale warning when CtrlProxy is frozen ([#10631](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10631)) (android)
- CtrlProxy status check treats an adb timeout as not installed and reinstalls, spending 120 s of the acquisition budget ([#10630](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10630)) (android)
- overlay-agent download: overlapping downloads share one .download partial path ([#10629](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10629)) (ios)
- tapOn by testTag never matches overlay nodes (the tag is reported as resource-id) ([#10626](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10626)) (android)
- prototype status can report overlay state one action behind observe ([#10622](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10622))
- getAndroid permanently rejects a discovered emulator pooled as 'Unknown (<serial>)' (stale pool identity, never upgraded) ([#10603](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10603))
- stdio proxy: after session_recovery_pending, later calls on the same connection hang until timeout, even after the device returns ([#10508](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10508)) (daemon)
- sessions: a session whose owning client connection closed still blocks a new client's getAndroid until heartbeat timeout ([#10503](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10503)) (daemon)
- ios: hierarchy, storage and database CtrlProxy requests bypass sendCommand and carry no deadline ([#10500](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10500)) (ios)
- device leases: release CtrlProxy forwarding when idle, reclaim from stale or orphaned owners ([#10497](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10497)) (android)
- sessions: release a physical Android device's session as soon as the phone is disconnected ([#10493](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10493)) (android)
- stdio proxy: a tool call refused as daemon_session_suspect is returned to the agent instead of retried after liveness recovery ([#10491](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10491)) (daemon)
- getAndroid hangs ~60 s instead of failing fast when another daemon holds the device's CtrlProxy forwarding lease ([#10485](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10485)) (android)
- observe/skeleton (android): mark a skeleton row `occluded` when an application window covers its tap point, so observe and tapOn agree ([#10481](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10481)) (android, bot-filed, routine:tracker-hygiene)
- keyboard open (android): reported IME bounds are read before the keyboard window settles and can be off screen ([#10480](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10480)) (android, bot-filed, routine:tracker-hygiene)
- element-resolution: the resolver lacks ElementFinder's synthetic-id guards (bare s- duplicates, legacy duplicate ids, id on an actionless node) ([#10476](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10476))
- test: FfmpegVideoProcessingBackendPostProcessBudget times out on a loaded Linux runner (auto-advance fake time waits on real event-loop turns) ([#10471](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10471)) (flaky test)
- overlay(android): textSize ignores the system font scale (dp converted to sp) ([#10436](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10436)) (android, a11y)
- overlay(android): onTap hit area excludes the node's padding and has no 48 dp minimum touch target ([#10435](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10435)) (android, a11y)
- overlay(android): Material components render in the baseline light scheme — no MaterialTheme, bottomNav/textField clash with dark specs, sheets default to white ([#10434](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10434)) (android)
- overlay(android): nodes inside a scroll container are missing from observe and unreachable by tapOn (scroll child reports 11 px wide bounds) ([#10433](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10433)) (android)
- ime (android): CtrlProxyIme caps every commit at a fixed 4 s, so long ime-mode sendKeys text is cut short on a physical phone ([#10417](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10417)) (android)

- sendKeys (Android) ime mode: verifyImeCommit runs a full observe with performance audit after every command (~2.3 s each on a physical phone) ([#10412](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10412))

- ctrlproxy(android): caret reported unplaced when ACTION_SET_SELECTION returns false but the node already shows the caret at the planned offset (breaks eventLast in a rich-text composer) ([#10403](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10403))

- plan: critical-section sub-step failure captures an observe while the lock is held, and reuses the section's observation in plan output (follow-up to #10383) ([#10384](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10384))
- test: CodeQL alerts in tests — insecure temp files in daemonNamespace.test.ts and an unanchored regex in networkMockRules.test.ts ([#10358](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10358))

- sendKeys (android): default-mode replace empties a hinted EditText and never types the replacement ("IME partial commit … holds <hint>") ([#10252](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10252)) (bot-filed, routine:exploratory)
- navigation graph: a step replayed by navigateTo is stored as a second transition because platform and deviceId are added to its arguments ([#10248](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10248)) (android, ios, daemon)
- launchApp (android): the package-only launcher am start never resolves on API 36, so every launch takes the monkey fallback ([#10247](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10247)) (android)
- storage subscription (android): a refused subscribe to a stopped app starts its process, and the next subscribe says "SharedPreferences inspection is disabled" again ([#10246](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10246)) (android, blocked)

- navigateTo: an edge recorded by a searching tapOn keeps the selected tabs of the screen the tool started on, and UI-state setup then taps a matching button and leaves the source screen ([#10244](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10244)) (android)
- accessibility audit (android): the contrast check samples the background as the text colour, so legible text on a dark theme is reported at about 1:1 ([#10243](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10243)) (android, a11y)
- desktop: DaemonSocketPaths forks `id -u` on every path lookup: four forks before each click-to-tap or keystroke, and one on the UI thread per root recomposition ([#10238](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10238)) (performance, desktop)
- desktop: the session heartbeat loop re-sends setActiveDevice every 2 s for the focused pane, so the daemon rescans devices and logs a bind line indefinitely ([#10237](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10237)) (desktop, daemon)
- desktop(stdio): McpStdioClient never restarts its MCP server after the child exits, so every request fails until the app is restarted ([#10236](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10236)) (desktop)
- ide-plugin: test-plan inspection attaches a step error to the first matching key in the file, so the "Change tool" quick fix rewrites the wrong step ([#10235](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10235)) (intellij plugin)
- ctrlproxy(ios physical): a start while the previous xcodebuild is still alive launches a second runner and orphans the first, which stop() never terminates ([#10234](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10234)) (ios, needs-device-verify)
- desktop(http): McpHttpClient sends no Accept header and cannot read SSE replies, so it never initializes against the daemon's streamable endpoint, and a lost session is never recovered ([#10233](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10233)) (desktop)
- ctrlproxy(ios physical): a runner restart moves the service port away from the live iproxy tunnel, so every start after the first times out ([#10232](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10232)) (ios, needs-device-verify)
- desktop: the pane session-provider lambda is rebuilt on every root recomposition, so dragging a pane divider or focusing another pane reconnects the Logs, Performance, Failures and control streams ([#10231](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10231)) (desktop)
- ci: a failed unit timing budget step can show no failing verdict in the job log ([#10230](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10230)) (ci)
- tapOn (android): an element whose centre is under a dialog or popup window is tapped there anyway, so the covering window gets the touch and the call reports success ([#10226](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10226)) (android, needs-device-verify)
- tapOn (android): a text selector that also matches a soft-keyboard key taps the key, which observe never listed, and reports success ([#10225](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10225)) (android)

- ci: property-based unit tests time out at 5 s on a loaded runner in the coverage step ([#10213](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10213)) (flaky test, ci)

- session release: a plan that is cancelled or times out releases its session under the aborted request signal, so network-condition and biometric restores never reach the device and the device is marked unhealthy ([#10198](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10198)) (android, ios, daemon)
- predictive UI: observe predictions and prediction outcomes read the global navigation graph manager, so a session never gets any ([#10197](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10197)) (daemon)
- navigation: the 2 s tool-call window is measured from when the tool started, so a tapOn that waits for its target stores its edge with no tool and navigateTo replays it as Back ([#10196](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10196)) (daemon)
- navigation telemetry: the graph manager's event takes its device from the recorder's last context (wrong device with two Android devices), and iOS records every navigation twice ([#10195](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10195)) (android, ios, daemon)
- navigation graph: every traversal adds a navigation_edges row that is never pruned, and explore validate coverage, edgesAdded and getNavigationGraph count rows as transitions ([#10194](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10194)) (daemon)
- navigation: once another app has been in front, the SDK app's current screen is forgotten — navigateTo says no events were recorded and the next transition stores no edge ([#10193](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10193)) (android, daemon)
- launchApp (android): an app removed outside the tools is still "installed" in the 5-minute cache, so the launch runs every fallback and fails with "No launcher activity found" instead of "App is not installed" ([#10192](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10192)) (android)
- installApp (android): an install that hits the 120 s adb timeout is reported failed with no package-state check and no cache invalidation, although the device can still finish it ([#10191](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10191)) (android)
- changeLocalization: a time zone id that does not exist is written to the device and reported as success (the read-back compares the stored string with itself) ([#10190](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10190)) (android, ios)
- setAppPermissions / getAppPermissions (android): a restricted permission is parsed as "<name>: restricted=true", so grant/revoke is refused as "not requested" and reads report it as unknown ([#10189](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10189)) (android)
- videoRecording (ios simulator): stop kills the ffmpeg re-encode after a fixed 60 s, so a long recording started with a resolution fails with "FFmpeg post-processing failed" ([#10188](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10188)) (ios, video)
- videoRecording: automobile:video/latest resolves to an interrupted recording whose file was deleted or never pulled, returning ENOENT instead of the last playable recording ([#10187](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10187)) (android, ios, video)
- videoRecording (android): a screenrecord that exits right after spawn is reported as a started recording, and the later stop error drops its exit code and stderr ([#10186](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10186)) (android, video)
- tapOn: visual selected-state fallback reports the tapped element as selected on the screen it navigated to, and treats a failed image comparison as a 100% change ([#10185](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10185)) (android, ios)

- daemon: a response over 1 MiB that is still draining gets the client's socket destroyed by the next frame written to it ([#10176](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10176)) (daemon)

- sdk(android): setKeyValue, removeKeyValue and clearKeyValueFile report success after Editor.apply(), before the write is on disk — a process kill right after loses it, and a failed write is never reported ([#10168](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10168)) (android, sdk)
- sendKeys (ios): typed text is never read back, so a field that rejected, reformatted or autocorrected the input is reported as plain success ([#10167](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10167)) (ios)
- sqlQuery (ios): a mutation waiting on the app's write lock is reported as failed after 2 s and can still be applied; the wait also blocks the SDK server's health and hierarchy routes ([#10166](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10166)) (ios, database)
- sdk(ios): a database locked by the app is reported as an empty table list, unknown_table, or mutation_not_authorized for a SELECT ([#10165](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10165)) (ios, database, sdk)
- sdk(ios): the database inspector keeps serving a deleted-and-recreated database from its cached connection, and writes go to the deleted file ([#10164](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10164)) (ios, database, sdk)
- changeLocalization (android): a rejected app locale is left applied as und or a truncated tag after the call fails ([#10155](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10155)) (android)
- navigateTo (android): a replayed tapOn edge does not scroll to an off-screen target, so edges recorded on a long list fail ([#10154](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10154)) (android)
- executePlan: a labelled plan cannot allocate when its base session holds a device and no other device is idle ([#10153](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10153)) (android)
- keyboard open (android): the caret still moves on a Compose field with no stable selector, and bounds can be off screen ([#10152](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10152)) (android)

- ctrlproxy(android): focus on an already-focused node and clear_focus on an unfocused node are refused as unavailable, so a repeated accessibilityFocus or TalkBack boomerang swipe fails ([#10148](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/10148)) (android)

### Added

- criticalSection/executePlan: warnings from earlier successful steps are lost when a later step fails ([#6909](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6909))
- test(element-targeting): shared hierarchy arbitrary + ElementParser shape-tolerance properties ([#6472](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6472)) (android, ios, testing)

- fix: handle iOS 16+ "Allow Paste" alert on non-English locales ([#1881](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/1881)) (ios)

### Changed

- Dead Code Detection: Threshold Exceeded ([#9649](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9649)) (automated, dead-code)

- Optional bindFileBackedDbHarness() hooks binder (deferred from #3081 item 3) ([#3101](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/3101)) (testing)

### Fixed

- tapOn (android): tapping a disabled element reports success with no indication that the element is disabled ([#9766](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9766)) (android)

- displayConfig (android): a successful non-reset call loses its message, and the night-mode baseline is never cleared when the device changes ([#9743](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9743)) (android)
- talkback(android): an id-addressed accessibility action can still hit an off-screen duplicate, because the host cannot see nodes the extractor drops ([#9742](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9742)) (android)
- accessibility(android): a persistently failing TalkBack probe costs an extra adb call on every observe and gesture, with no backoff ([#9725](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9725)) (android)
- navigation resources: with two device sessions the unscoped graph and history resources return the launcher with an empty graph ([#9723](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9723)) (android)
- displayConfig (android): reset reports "Font scale remained 1 after requesting default" although the reset worked, and turns a dark device light ([#9722](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9722)) (android)
- identifyInteractions (android): Compose buttons are classified as input fields and get a tapOn focus suggestion ([#9721](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9721)) (android)
- executePlan, appLifecycle, crashApp, getAppPermissions, highlight, recordSteps, exportPlan, explore: a failed operation is returned without isError ([#9720](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9720)) (android)
- sendKeys (android): type with no focused editable field reports success and types nothing ([#9719](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9719)) (android)
- daemon: a silent request with a budget above 15 minutes is cut by the idle-socket timeout before its own deadline ([#9718](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9718)) (daemon)
- observe (android): returns the previous app's hierarchy for up to 0.85 s after an app switch, flagged stale but not re-read ([#9706](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9706)) (android)
- tapOn (android): a tap sent after launchApp uses the mid-transition bounds from the unsettled cached observation, misses, and reports success ([#9705](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9705)) (android)
- tapOn (android): an element under the soft keyboard that extends below the keyboard view is tapped inside the IME's navigation bar and reported as success ([#9704](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9704)) (android)
- Windows flake: oxlintConfigScoping.integration.test.ts times out spawning "oxlint --print-config" (20 s hook timeout) ([#9702](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9702)) (ci)
- navigation: an observe hierarchy update without a package name still attaches another app's screen to the previous app's SDK node ([#9699](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9699)) (android)
- observe(android): hierarchy conversion drops enabled="false", so a disabled control reads as enabled and its state change never appears in a diff ([#9696](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9696)) (android)
- observe waitFor.absent: an unavailable or error hierarchy satisfies the wait on the first poll ([#9695](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/9695)) (android, ios)

## Unreleased

### Changed

- Breaking: XCTestRunner plan tests now use `try await executePlan()` in `async throws` test methods. Synchronous MCP client methods, the executor's `sessionIdProvider` initializer parameter, and public `AutoMobileSession` are removed; use async clients and explicit `sessionUuid` or `idGenerator`. Suite timing prefetch preserves its synchronous boundary and existing ordering behavior. (#6061) (ios)
- The iOS SDK sub-package manifests (`ios/auto-mobile-sdk`, `ios/highlight-core`) now declare the same iOS 17 / macOS 15 floor as the published root `Package.swift` and `XCTestRunner` (iOS 17 was introduced in #6773). This is a breaking change for apps or tools that depend on those sub-packages directly and target iOS 15/16 or macOS 13/14. (#5839) (ios)
- The public iOS SDK types `NetworkFaultTransport`, `NetworkFaultAction`, `NetworkFaultRuleDTO`, `NetworkMockRuleStore.FaultRequest`, and `NetworkMockRuleStore.FaultDecision` gained `Sendable` conformance; `DatabaseInspector`, `NetworkMockRuleStore`, `NetworkCaptureRecorder`, `URLSessionNetworkCaptureAdapter`, `WebSocketNetworkCaptureAdapter`, `NWConnectionNetworkCaptureAdapter`, and `AutoMobileWebViewPolicy` now conform to checked `Sendable` instead of `@unchecked Sendable`. These changes are source-compatible and additive. (#5839) (ios)
- The iOS SDK types `AutoMobileBiometrics`, `AutoMobileFailures`, `AutoMobileNetwork`, `AutoMobileNotifications`, `AutoMobileInteractionTracker`, `ViewBodyTracker`, `NavigationAdapterHub`, `DeepLinkNavigationAdapter`, `CustomNavigationAdapter`, `UIKitNavigationAdapter`, `SwiftUINavigationAdapter`, `BlockNavigationListener`, `DefaultAutoMobileAPI`, `DefaultAutoMobileCrashesAPI`, and `DefaultAutoMobileNetworkAPI` now conform to checked `Sendable` instead of `@unchecked Sendable`. These changes are source-compatible and additive. (#5839) (ios)

### Removed

- Remove the deprecated `captureScreenshot` MCP tool. Use `observe({ screenshot: "settled" })` and its `screenshotPath` for a fresh, validated screenshot.

## [v0.0.71] - 2026-09-10

### Other

- cli: the built-in help advertises forms the schemas reject — 'tapOn --text "Submit"' fails, union params render as the word "union", and bare --help starts a server then stack-traces ([#6817](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6817)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)
- systemTray(tap): returns the pre-tap shade as observationDiff.reason='diff_emitted', so an inline Reply that worked reads as a no-op ([#6816](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6816)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)

- mcp: acquiring a device session removes 57 of 84 tools from tools/list, and nothing names the 57 — an LLM client cannot reach setToolEnabled for a tool it can no longer see ([#6814](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6814)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)

## [v0.0.70] - 2026-09-10

### Fixed

- ctrlproxy(ios): shutdown's 1.2s/250ms budget cannot cover terminateProcessTree's TERM+KILL ladder ([#6578](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6578)) (ios)
- session: teardown preempts only the current lifecycle owner, so a queued start resumes against the destroyed device ([#6549](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6549)) (android, ios)
- daemon: shutdown watchdog is armed only on the stdin path, so a hung SIGTERM shutdown never self-exits ([#6541](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6541)) (enhancement)
- setActiveDevice: a device whose session is mid-release reads as free, so the rebind runs concurrently with that session's device teardown ([#6398](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6398)) (enhancement)
- bug(session): direct device binding bypasses pending cleanup quarantine ([#6365](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6365))
- sendKeys: required `platform` breaks device-targeting (+ post-execution freshness bound) — untracked residuals from PR #6053 ([#6345](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6345)) (bot-filed, routine:tracker-hygiene)

### Other

- mcpVersion: `npm_package_version` outranks the package manifest, so a 0.0.69 install announces itself as 0.0.68 and is refused by the 0.0.69 daemon ([#6803](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6803)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)
- mcp: two blocking errors name the problem but not the next call (disabled-tool gating, multi-platform ambiguity) ([#6797](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6797)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)
- observe(android): skeleton label takes `text` over `content-desc`, so all four quick-settings tiles read "On"/"Off" and Wi-Fi is unidentifiable ([#6794](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6794)) (bot-filed, routine:dogfood)
- #6069 foreign-session guard (#6687) does not cover autolock ownership: an autolock-pinned connection still routes a genuinely-issued FOREIGN session to a device it never acquired ([#6729](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6729)) (bot-filed, routine:adversary, needs-human)
- bug(daemon): recover package-launched clients with unknown version identity ([#6245](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6245))

### Fixed

- logger: transient WriteStream open failure permanently discards all logs; JSON diagnostic breaks NDJSON (from #6111) ([#6179](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6179))
- networkCondition TTL: preserve deadline on failed reset + mirror TTL maximum in plan schemas (from #6113) ([#6178](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6178))
- networkCondition TTL: expiry cleanup lacks per-condition generation guard, can return a shaped device unrestored (P1, from #6113) ([#6177](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6177))
- barrier lags criticalSection in Android ValidTools and PlanValidator (plan-validation parity) ([#6175](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6175))
- parseArgs: --port / --host / --initial-session-uuid swallow the next flag when given no value (proxy-mode sibling of #6136) ([#6168](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6168))
- setToolEnabled accepts a never-issued sessionUuid and reports success, while every other session tool rejects it (#6069 follow-up) ([#6148](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6148)) (bot-filed, routine:manual-test)
- Daemon client path: platform-aware + non-destructive connectOnce/waitForReady (Windows named-pipe e2e + downstream stale-socket unlink) ([#6140](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6140))
- PlanExecutor.captureFailureObservation cancels its timeout with global clearTimeout (not the injected Timer) and skips cancellation on the error path ([#6139](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6139))
- DefaultRetryExecutor leaks one abort listener per retry on the caller's AbortSignal (never removed when the sleep wins the race) ([#6138](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6138))
- IOSCtrlProxyProcessClient.isRunning treats `kill -0` EPERM ("Operation not permitted") as "not running"; the stderr guard is unreachable ([#6137](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6137)) (ios)
- parseDaemonArgs swallows the next flag when --host / --plan-execution-lock-scope / --tool-outputs-dir is given no value (`--host --debug` starts a non-debug daemon) ([#6136](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6136))
- daemon/heartbeat is queued behind in-flight tools/call on the same socket, so a bound session can be reaped (heartbeat-timeout) during a long unattributed acquisition like startDevice for a second device ([#6135](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6135))
- iOS hierarchy stream diff never flags a node that only moved/resized: `nodeSignature` stringifies the iOS `$.bounds` object to "[object Object]" ([#6134](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6134)) (ios, desktop)
- Paginated table-data resource template only matches when both `limit` and `offset` are present in that exact order; handler and description say each is optional ([#6133](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6133)) (database)
- startDevice min/maxOsVersion means release version to the device matcher but API level to the Android provisioner, so one value cannot satisfy both (provisioning fails or re-creates AVDs) ([#6132](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6132)) (android)
- FileDownloader Node-HTTP fallback hangs forever when the server closes the connection mid-body (no response error/close handler, truncated file left behind) ([#6131](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6131))
- NavigationRepository.getOrCreateUIElement never matches falsy identifiers (`""` text, `0` bounds) — inserts a duplicate `ui_elements` row on every tap ([#6130](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6130)) (database)
- rotate (Android) reads `user_rotation`, which is stale under auto-rotate, so a landscape device is reported "already in portrait" and never rotated; auto-rotate is left disabled ([#6129](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6129)) (android)
- swipeOn OverlayDetector counts the container's own clickable/focusable ancestors as overlays, forcing the "No unobstructed swipe area" fallback ([#6128](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6128))
- WCAG touch-target check compares physical pixels to a 44 dp threshold without density scaling (33 dp targets pass on xxhdpi, px reported as dp) ([#6127](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6127)) (android, a11y)
- explore resetToHome re-fires on every iteration while interactionCount sits on a multiple of resetInterval (including 0), then never relaunches the app ([#6126](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6126))
- Memory audit GC metrics are always 0 on ART: logcat filter (`-s dalvikvm:I art:I | grep "GC_"`) and regex only match Dalvik-era output ([#6125](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6125)) (android, performance)
- TouchLatencyTracker only counts a "response" when a jank counter increments, so a smooth app is reported as frozen and touchLatencyMs is always null ([#6124](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6124)) (android, performance)
- explore permission-dialog detection/dismissal still uses bare substring keywords ("access", "ok") — same defect class as #4190 ([#6122](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6122))
- explore passes both `text` and `elementId` to tapOn, so every element with text + resource-id fails "exactly one selector" validation and is never tapped ([#6121](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6121))
- logPruner: daemon's own-file cap claims peer `daemon-launch-<pid>.log` files, deleting the daemon's rotated backups while launch logs are never swept ([#6120](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6120))
- PortManager.allocate() rejects every host port on hosts without an IPv6 loopback (::1 bind failure treated as "port busy") ([#6119](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6119))
- MCP progress notifications never reach clients: tools/call handler fabricates progressToken instead of echoing `_meta.progressToken` ([#6118](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6118))
- barrier plan step drops its `device` label at schema.parse, so every track's barrier routes to the base session's device and fails as a duplicate arrival ([#6117](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6117))
- TalkBack swipeOn maps finger direction to the inverted ACTION_SCROLL (up → scroll_backward), so lookFor scrolls away from the target ([#6116](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6116)) (android, a11y)
- Plan schema false-rejects params-overridden inline setDeviceState fields (doNotDisturb + audit; networkCondition done in #6090) ([#6112](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6112)) (enhancement)
- secretParameters parser: multiline YAML flow-sequence declarations drop keys (fail-open redaction gap) ([#6097](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6097))
- doctor host-command timeout sends SIGTERM with no SIGKILL escalation — a wedged check can hang past DOCTOR_EXEC_TIMEOUT_MS ([#6018](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/6018)) (ios, bot-filed, routine:tracker-hygiene)
- iOS video-recording integration test (#5984) can never assert: skipped by default, and fails on the videoRecording session tool gate when enabled ([#5987](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/5987)) (ios, testing, bot-filed, routine:manual-test)

- getAppPermissions fails on iOS simulator: sqlite3 called with '.mode json' + SQL in one positional arg ('extra argument') ([#2603](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2603))
- Daemon restart desyncs connected MCP clients: all tool calls + resource reads return opaque 'Session not found' with no auto-recovery ([#2599](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2599))
- clipboard get on Android returns empty success when the read is denied by ClipboardService (background a11y), and cmd clipboard fallback doesn't exist ([#2596](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2596))
- changeLocalization silently fails on Android: reports success but the system locale never changes (invalid 'cmd locale set-locales', no-op fallback, no verification) ([#2595](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2595))
- sqlQuery: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE ... RETURNING on Android commits the mutation but returns an error (RETURNING not recognized by isReadQuery) ([#2594](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2594))
- CtrlProxy APK refresh blocks every tool call on slow/no network (~30s each); local ops like sqlQuery hang offline ([#2590](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2590))
- tool_calls.duration_ms is never populated (NULL for all rows) — per-call timing not recorded ([#2588](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2588))
- iOS startDevice/listDeviceImages returns "Available images: none" despite a booted, available simulator ([#2572](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2572))
- MCP tool errors discard subprocess stderr / daemon-log context, surfacing only opaque messages ([#2562](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2562))
- Multi-daemon detection false-positive: a single daemon's own shell wrapper is counted as an "other" daemon ([#2561](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2561))
- Daemon inherits spawner cwd; a deleted cwd makes forked children fail ENOENT, misreported as "Android emulator not found" ([#2560](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2560))
- Concurrent instances crash on startup with SQLiteError: database is locked (no busy_timeout) ([#2559](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2559))
- openLink lacks an MCP request-timeout floor; slow deeplinks fail with -32001 ([#2558](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2558))
- junit-runner and manager.ts hardcode @latest, defeating consumer version pinning ([#2386](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2386))
- Detect Compose interop content hiding and signal OCR fallback ([#2374](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2374))
- launchApp rejects 'packageId' parameter — LLM commonly uses wrong field name ([#2217](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2217))

### Other

- Client can silently use a daemon of a mismatched version (@latest spawn + restart cooldown) ([#2452](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2452))
- Crash/force-kill leaves stale PID and socket files; no exit-time cleanup ([#2451](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2451))
- Device disconnects are not surfaced to observation-stream subscribers ([#2450](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2450))
- Screenshot backoff stops after initial burst; live view freezes on static screens ([#2449](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2449))
- Observation stream pushes no initial frame on subscribe; idle devices show blank ([#2448](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2448))
- Observation-stream request_observation command is a no-op; socket clients cannot force a frame ([#2447](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2447))
- Daemon stream socket paths are not discoverable, causing silent connect failures on env mismatch ([#2446](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2446))
- Device pool never prunes shut-down devices, wedging discovery until daemon restart ([#2445](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2445))
- Daemon readiness inferred from PID/socket-file existence, not an actual connection ([#2444](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2444))
- Device held ~30s when a client dies before its first heartbeat ([#2443](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2443))
- iOS device pool never auto-boots an installed-but-shutdown simulator to satisfy criteria ([#2442](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2442))
- Daemon version skew is only reconciled one direction; stale daemon can serve newer clients ([#2441](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2441))
- Add a fast `--version` flag; today it hangs by falling through to the stdio server ([#2440](https://github.com/kaeawc/auto-mobile/issues/2440))

## [0.0.4] - 2025-07-08

### Added

- Automate Accessibility Service install and enablement on first ADB command for a device
- Check APK SHA256 before installing
- Allow element search to restrict to specific containers in the view hierarchy

### Changed

- Increase accessibility node inspection for better view hierarchy data
- Filter unnecessary view hierarchy data to reduce observe payloads
- Parallelize and cache observation and idling steps
- Refactor BaseVisualChange
- Reduce tool calls to make it easier for agents to determine tool call selection
